rule.text: The official confession affirms Scripture is without error (inerrant) and the final authority (also worded "supreme standard", "ultimate authority" or "only infallible rule of faith and practice") → GREEN. Both halves need a quote.

ledger.quote: The Book of Church Order , commonly referred to as BCO , is part of the constitution of the Presbyterian Church in America, which is subject to and subordinate to the Scriptures of the Old and New Testaments, the inerrant Word Of God.
